title: Odometer Bands and the Interval a Keyturn Vehicle Listing Is Granted
content:
The highest odometer reading standing on the condition record of a Keyturn Vehicle Listing places the vehicle in one of three bands, and the band takes interval off the next grant.

- A vehicle whose highest odometer reading standing on the condition record is 120000 miles or more has 2500 miles taken off.
- A vehicle whose highest standing reading is 80000 miles or more but below 120000 has 1000 miles taken off.
- A vehicle below 80000 miles has nothing taken off on this ground, a reduction of 0 miles.

*At the boundaries.* A vehicle whose highest standing reading is exactly 120000 miles is in the top band and has 2500 miles taken off; at 119999 miles it is in the middle band and has 1000 taken off. At exactly 80000 miles it is in the middle band; at 79999 miles it is in the bottom band and has nothing taken off.

*Which reading is read.* The highest standing on the condition record, not the most recent, so a later reading lower than an earlier one does not move the vehicle down a band.
